mapper.select: SELECT id, pilot_id, title, url, description, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM pilot_figmas WHERE pilot_id = #{pilotId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pilot_figmas (pilot_id, title, url, description, order_num, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{pilotId}, #{title}, #{url}, #{description}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE pilot_figmas SET title = #{title}, url = #{url}, description = #{description}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
